phrases.text: Neck pain can interrupt the smallest moments of your day.
Even a simple turn toward someone you love.
Working.
Reading.
Even getting comfortable at night.
So where do you begin?
Maybe it's the task you keep putting aside,
or a quiet family moment you want to be present for.
Comfort, concentration, rest and confidence all matter.
What does it interrupt for you?
It's tempting to look for one quick fix.
But every neck, and every day, is different.
So care starts somewhere else: with your story.
Your symptoms, your routine, and what you want to get back to.
At Munaza Physio Studio in Lahore,
Dr. Munaza Ghani offers women-only physiotherapy
in a private, respectful space.
She listens first.
You share only what you're comfortable sharing,
ask questions, and make choices about your care.
What happens at an assessment?
Dr. Munaza talks with you about when your neck feels uncomfortable,
and what makes it easier.
She observes how you move, gently and comfortably.
Together, you choose the everyday activities that matter most,
like desk work, reading, or resting at night.
Listen. Assess. Set goals.
What could your plan include?
Depending on your assessment, it may include
guided movement and strengthening,
practical changes to your desk, phone and sleeping setup,
and hands-on care, when it's appropriate and you agree to it.
There's no single routine for everyone.
Your plan is built around you.
Then comes practice:
a few movements, at a pace that suits your day.
Some days feel easier than others, and that's okay.
At follow-up visits, you review what's changed,
ask questions, and adjust the plan together.
Step by step, you work toward more comfortable movement.
How do you take the first step?
On munazaphysio.studio, open the menu,
choose What We Treat, then Neck Pain.
Read how care works, and learn about Dr. Munaza.
Then tap Book Now and choose an initial assessment.
Care starts with understanding your day.
Start with a neck-pain assessment
at Munaza Physio Studio.
Women-only physiotherapy, in Lahore.
